verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a SaaS platform with its own AI features (AI Editor, Sprinto AI evidence analysis), so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack never documents a setting or policy that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Its AI governance and Shadow AI features help customers govern other AI systems, which is an adjacent capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
